dialogues.speaker: Yelagina
dialogues.text: The Kresnik's Torch is running as it should. Let's begin today's log...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This furnace looks different from the others...

dialogues.speaker: Yelagina
dialogues.text: Of course it does. This is the central Kresnik's Torch — the most important one in all of Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Yelagina
dialogues.text: After His Majesty the Belyi Tsar completed his experiments in the Pale Crown Palace, construction began almost immediately. It's stood here ever since... for longer than I can even say.

dialogues.speaker: Yelagina
dialogues.text: Over the years, countless people have dedicated themselves to keeping this enormous machine running.

dialogues.speaker: Yelagina
dialogues.text: It burns the Kresnik Kristall. That's why it's called the Kresnik's Torch.

dialogues.speaker: Yelagina
dialogues.text: A lot of people assume the ore was named after the Torch, but if you stop and think about it, the ore must have existed first, right? Haha.

dialogues.speaker: Yelagina
dialogues.text: The ore is brought in by rail from Novokitezhgrad.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll let you get on with your work.
